body:
The frozen BDS-C method improves P-GRB on five of six prospectively selected draws, but exposes a consequential U6 regression. At the common 3600-second cap, U6 gap is 34.3090% worse than P and 59.0955% worse than K1-R: stronger L does not offset weaker U. K1 itself improves P by 15.5796%. The overall research goal remains unmet.

All six inputs were fixed before generation, with no rejected/reseeded draws. These are unadapted draws from familiar recipes with disclosed CitiBike station overlap. The qualified R78 source, executable, preset, tolerances and official P model are unchanged; no default change or main merge.

- All 18 original arms returned normally and passed physical, coverage, numerical and identity audits: 81 Optimize calls, 32889.548 seconds paid wall.
- 84 audited checkpoints show U6's late ordering reversal; missing early K1 U is not backdated. Nine actual Start decisions pass (eight eligible/accepted; one correctly ineligible).
- Nineteen bundles containing 18,523 files pass full byte verification twice. Reviewed plots retain the initial layout issue and its separate correction with identical data.
- U1/U2 retain material certification-time gains, U3 gains a P certificate, and U4/U5 reduce P gap by 45.4351%/68.3163%. These gains do not cancel U6.

[Full results, mechanism and resource report](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/blob/30996a5c023adc2257cf9f4581e3672cf9a644d1/results/unified_exact_round82/final_report.md) · [Reproduction](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/blob/30996a5c023adc2257cf9f4581e3672cf9a644d1/results/unified_exact_round82/reproduce.md)

Stacked on R81 final `298e97f5d163a54eb9d899c664cafd9f07c8647c` (draft #142). A net-load-preserving served-block exchange is documented only as the next hypothesis; it is not implemented or experimentally admitted here. Any revision informed by R82 needs new unadapted confirmation.
title: Round82: retain five P gains and the U6 confirmation regression
